en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a rural crossroads with a simple wooden bridge in the foreground leading to a dirt road that splits into two. On the left is a wooden house with fenced yard; on the right is another wooden building and open, rocky ground. Trees and picket fences line the road, and a couple of people stand near the center distance. In the sky area at the top right is printed text that appears to read "Sandvik, Sesskarö."
